subject.title: File Browser: Remove ALLOWED_FILE_NAMES whitelist, add scope levels

question: Should OpenClaw add editable workspace-wide and/or host-system file browsing to Control UI, and what permission boundary should replace the current allowlisted editor?
rationale: The remaining request would broaden Gateway file read/write access beyond the deliberate allowlist, and the safe product boundary cannot be inferred from code alone.

options.title: Approve Workspace-Only Mutations
options.body: Design admin-scoped, fs-safe-confined workspace mutation methods with size limits, audit posture, destructive-operation UX, and Control UI proof while excluding host-system browsing.

options.title: Keep Read-Only Workspace Browsing
options.body: Preserve the allowlisted editor plus read-only workspace preview until a stronger need for browser-based workspace writes is accepted.

options.title: Open Separate System-Files Design
options.body: Handle host filesystem browsing as its own explicit operator opt-in design with read-only defaults, recovery, and security review.

recommendation.title: Approve Workspace-Only Mutations
recommendation.body: Design admin-scoped, fs-safe-confined workspace mutation methods with size limits, audit posture, destructive-operation UX, and Control UI proof while excluding host-system browsing.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the landed read-only workspace API and related app/browser file-viewer work that partially covers this request.
